thingsToDo.title: Visit Lakeland
thingsToDo.description: Lakeland is a waterfront in Jacksonville, Florida. Nearby day trip: Lakeland is a coastal town in Florida, about 27 miles from Jacksonville. It is a short drive from Jacksonville with time for beach walks, salty-air viewpoints, and breezy shoreline paths. Plan it as a half-day escape and return to Jacksonville by evening.
